title: Lindy Lou Charters

services.name: Kid Fishing
services.desc: We offer a 3 Hour kids fishing and private dolphin tour that is designed specifically to cater to your children. The first hour and a half will be spent fishing and then the remainder half will be spent cruising and spotting dolphins up close and personal. (You also have the option to fish the whole time if your children prefer to.) Our kids trips will take place in the back bayous or the Destin Harbor. Some of the species expected to catch will be catfish, pinfish, redfish, croaker, pigfish and many others. These trips are catch and release.
